Bottom SheetContainment

The `m3e-bottom-sheet` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
[ M3e.Component.Button.button [] [ M3e.Component.BottomSheetTrigger.bottomsheettrigger [ M3e.Component.BottomSheetTrigger.for "bottomSheet" ] [ TypedHtml.text "Open bottom sheet" ] ]
, M3e.Component.BottomSheet.bottomsheet [ M3e.Attributes.id "bottomSheet" ]
[ M3e.Component.ActionList.actionlist []
[ M3e.Component.ListAction.listaction []
[ M3e.Component.BottomSheetAction.bottomsheetaction [] [ TypedHtml.text "Google Keep" ]
, M3e.Component.ListAction.supportingText (TypedHtml.text "Add to a note")
]
, M3e.Component.ListAction.listaction []
[ M3e.Component.BottomSheetAction.bottomsheetaction [] [ TypedHtml.text "Google Docs" ]
, M3e.Component.ListAction.supportingText (TypedHtml.text "Embed in a document")
]
]
]
]

component is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the component surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for component on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

build is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the build surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for build on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

<m3e-button>
<m3e-bottom-sheet-trigger for="bottomSheet"> Open bottom sheet </m3e-bottom-sheet-trigger>
</m3e-button>
<m3e-bottom-sheet id="bottomSheet">
<m3e-action-list>
<m3e-list-action>
<m3e-bottom-sheet-action>Google Keep</m3e-bottom-sheet-action>
<span slot="supporting-text">Add to a note</span>
</m3e-list-action>
<m3e-list-action>
<m3e-bottom-sheet-action>Google Docs</m3e-bottom-sheet-action>
<span slot="supporting-text">Embed in a document</span>
</m3e-list-action>
</m3e-action-list>
</m3e-bottom-sheet>

API

Types

type Is

The kind row m3e-bottom-sheet produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

M3eComponentsBuilderRaw

Other

bottomSheet : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Component.BottomSheet.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.BottomSheet.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Component.BottomSheet.Is s) admittedBy msg

See M3e.Component.BottomSheet.el.
